notifications.mail.domain_expiring_actio: Point the domain's DNS record (CNAME) to :target before :until, or the domain stops working on your website that day.
notifications.mail.domain_lost_subject: :domains no longer works on your website
notifications.mail.domain_lost_intro: :domains has not pointed to your website for 30 days, so it no longer works there. If it was the main address, the website now answers at its platform address.
notifications.mail.domain_lost_action: To use it again, point its DNS record (CNAME) to :target, then check the domain again in the website admin.
notifications.mail.domain_taken_over_int: Another website proved it owns :domains with a DNS (TXT) record, so the name was removed from your website.
notifications.mail.domain_taken_over_act: If you own this domain, add the TXT record shown in the website admin and check the domain again to take it back. Otherwise, contact us.

provisioning.hostname_not_platform_subdo: The address :host is not a platform subdomain, so nothing was changed. A new website starts on a name like your-site.:base; attach the customer's own domain afterwards with site:domain, where it is verified before it goes live.
provisioning.hostname_pending_verificati: A website is still proving it owns the address :host, so it cannot start a new website and nothing was changed. Choose another address.
provisioning.hostname_owned_by_another_t: The address :host already belongs to another customer's website, so nothing was changed. Check --host, or pass --tenant with the exact name of the customer who owns it.
provisioning.hostname_reserved_label: The name :label is kept for the platform's own services, so nothing was changed. Choose another name for this website, like your-site.:base.
provisioning.sites_limit_reached: Website limit reached: this customer's plan allows :limit and they already have :count. To add another website, move them to a plan that allows more.
provisioning.tenant_required: Choose the customer for this new website: --tenant=<ulid or exact name> for an existing customer, or --new-tenant="Customer name" to create one.
provisioning.tenant_both: Use only one of --tenant (an existing customer) or --new-tenant (a new customer).
provisioning.tenant_not_found: No customer ":reference" was found. Check the ulid or the name; if this is a new customer, use --new-tenant="Customer name".
provisioning.tenant_ambiguous: Several customers are named ":reference": :candidates. Run again with --tenant=<ulid> of the right one.
provisioning.tenant_did_you_mean: No customer is named exactly ":reference". Did you mean: :candidates? Run again with --tenant=<ulid> of that customer.
provisioning.tenant_name_too_long: The customer name is too long: :max characters at most.
provisioning.tenant_name_exists: A customer named ":name" already exists: :candidates. To add this website to them, run again with --tenant=<ulid>. Only if this is a different customer with the same name, add --allow-same-name.
provisioning.tenant_mismatch: The website :host already exists and belongs to customer :tenant, not the one you chose. Run again with --tenant=:tenant.
provisioning.tenant_host_taken: The website :host already exists (customer :tenant), so no new customer was created. To finish that website, run again with --tenant=:tenant.
provisioning.tenant_rerun_needs_tenant: The website :host already exists (customer :tenant). To finish it, run again with --tenant=:tenant.
provisioning.host_invalid: ":host" is not a hostname a website can use. Use letters, digits and hyphens, with at least two parts, e.g. shop.example.vn.
